There is no mystic without a story involving a tree. In my family, almost all the men were tree nurserymen; I became a carpenter and wood sculptor. It is not only the *Edda* that reveres the tree: in Norse mythology, Yggdrasil is the colossal World Tree that supports the entire universe as its axis—an ash tree, so the story goes. On Arunachala, one of the most sacred mountains, there is said to be a divine tree that no mystic has ever seen. Today I ordered a Serbian spruce, but that is another story. A beautiful tree.
